exposure: intrapartum referrals in primary midwife-led care births
cohort: 807,437 women with low-risk pregnancies in primary midwife-led care at the onset of labor in the Netherlands between 2000 and 2008
finding: The caesarean section rate increased significantly for nulliparous women, while vaginal instrumental deliveries declined for both nulliparous and multiparous women, alongside an increase in augmentation of labor and pharmacological pain relief.
mod_finding: The increase in augmentation of labor, pharmacological pain relief, and electronic fetal monitoring among women in primary midwife-led care was accompanied by an increase in the cesarean section rate for nulliparous women.
